title: Wind down loops when verification debt grows
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Long loops accumulate verification debt; Fangore winds them down when independent verification age or repeated failures exceed host thresholds. Accepts WalkingLabs L13 guidance[^wl-l13-loop].
implementation: `LoopHealthSignals` and `should_wind_down` in `mechaharness.loop_health` expose verification-debt and failure signals.
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.
